findings.label: CSS comments fold into the next declaration
findings.detail: The two /* ... */ comments inside .dismiss in the starter style.adx.css are emitted as a prefix to the following declaration in the generated style.css. Output is valid CSS and all token values resolve correctly; purely cosmetic generated-formatting. Already triaged 'no action required' by both prior reviewers and unchanged by this commit. A future codegen pass could strip or re-indent inline comments.
